```yaml
name: Gitbook Docs Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: 'Tag to backfill (e.g., v3.3.9)'
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  sync-gitbook:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Determine tag
        id: tag
        env:
          INPUT_TAG: ${{ github.event.inputs.tag }}
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "release" ]]; then
            TAG="${{ github.ref_name }}"
          else
            TAG="${INPUT_TAG}"
          fi
          echo "TAG=${TAG}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Parse version
        id: version
        run: |
          TAG="${{ steps.tag.outputs.TAG }}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$TAG"
          echo "major=${major}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "minor=${minor}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "patch=${patch}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create docs branch
        run: |
          major="${{ steps.version.outputs.major }}"
          minor="${{ steps.version.outputs.minor }}"
          patch="${{ steps.version.outputs.patch }}"
          branch="docs/v${major}.${minor}"
          git checkout -b "$branch" "refs/tags/v${major}.${minor}.${patch}"
          git push --force origin "$branch"

      - name: Create Gitbook variant (if patch == 0)
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.patch == '0' }}
        env:
          GITBOOK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}
          GITBOOK_SPACE_ID: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}
        run: |
          major="${{ steps.version.outputs.major }}"
          minor="${{ steps.version.outputs.minor }}"
          branch="docs/v${major}.${minor}"
          case "${major}.${minor}" in
            "3.3") variant_name="Rocky Romp" ;;
            *) variant_name="Release" ;;
          esac
          variant_full="V${major}.${minor} - ${variant_name}"
          echo "Creating variant '${variant_full}' for branch '${branch}'"
          curl -s -X POST "https://api.gitbook.com/v1/spaces/${GITBOOK_SPACE_ID}/variants" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITBOOK_TOKEN}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"name\":\"${variant_full}\",\"branch\":\"${branch}\"}"
```
